title: Automated Theory Competition Engine — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Tests competing scientific explanations against evidence and discriminating predictions. A proposed engine that runs scientific theories against each other: given competing explanations, it gathers the evidence, derives the predictions on which they disagree, and scores each theory by how well it predicts — retiring theories that lose and promoting the survivors. The competition is public and reproducible.
capabilities: Retire consistently losing theories with justification
Design experiments that best discriminate survivors
